hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] && [ -n "$repo_root" ] && [ -n "$file" ]; then case "$file" in "$repo_root"/*) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Direct edits to main are blocked — CLAUDE.md requires feature branches + PRs, even for small fixes. Create a branch first.\"}}" ;; esac; fi
